findings.rule: Surface treatment must be compatible with base material and supported by appropriate hardness.
findings.reasoning: Hard chrome plating is specified on M.S. (mild steel) with no heat treatment. Mild steel is too soft for a cam plate wearing against a follower; the chrome layer will crack or spall under contact stress because the substrate cannot support it. A cam plate requires through-hardening or case-hardening steel, not plain mild steel with chrome alone.
findings.correction: Change the material to a hardenable steel suitable for cam applications (e.g., EN8, EN19, or a case-hardening grade) and specify an appropriate heat treatment to achieve the required surface/core hardness before chrome plating.

findings.rule: GD&T feature control frames must have a readable tolerance value on the drawing.
findings.reasoning: Symbol S6 is identified as a position tolerance referencing datums A and B, but the actual tolerance value is unreadable per the uncertain list. Without a numeric tolerance zone the geometric requirement cannot be manufactured or inspected.
findings.correction: Add the missing positional tolerance value (e.g., Ø0.1) inside the feature control frame so it is legible at the stated scale.
